zh.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.1 收录上一版本之后的 {{commitCount}} 个提交。

sections.heading: Desktop 与会话表面
items: 安装包使用产品图标；Update Control 与窗口 inset 对齐，打包后的 Desktop Host 启动路径纳入 smoke。
Desktop 启用 Session Schedule，并提供可在冷会话上保存的任务板。

sections.heading: 远程、配对与账户
items: Settings 提供个人配对；Desktop pairing 账户重置会发布到客户端，并在失败时按生命周期重试。
加入 GitHub installation 账户会话，以及带能力协商与载荷上限的版本化 companion 协议。

sections.heading: 工具与界面
items: 工具搜索可延迟发现，并在恢复会话后重建可记录的 schema。
工具资格改为仅授权策略，在包装前拒绝不合格工具；Details 面板占用者可声明宽度范围。
Settings 由插件自有表面承载；提问框可折叠，并修正 Safari textarea 回流。

sections.heading: 安全与发布基线
items: 跨运行时 Noise 路径带有可验证证据，并在启动前登记 simulator 清理。
内置 dsh 跟随 0.1.0-rc.7；发布说明改用上一版本基线比较 `gestalt-v0.1.0` 之后的提交。

en.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.1 contains the {{commitCount}} commits after the previous Desktop Bundle.

sections.heading: Desktop and session surface
items: Installers use the product icon; Update Control aligns with the window inset, and the packaged Desktop Host launch path is covered by smoke.
Desktop enables Session Schedule and a task board that can persist on a cold session.

sections.heading: Remote access, pairing, and accounts
items: Settings provides personal pairing; Desktop pairing account resets publish to the client and retry across the pairing lifecycle.
GitHub installation account sessions land with a versioned companion protocol that negotiates capabilities and enforces payload ceilings.

sections.heading: Tools and interface
items: Tool search can be discovered later and reconstructs a logged schema after session restore.
Tool eligibility is allow-only and rejects ineligible tools before wrappers; details occupants can declare a width range.
Settings is owned by plugin surfaces; the question composer collapses, and Safari textarea reflow is corrected.

sections.heading: Security and release baseline
items: The cross-runtime Noise path carries verifiable evidence and registers simulator cleanup before boot.
The bundled dsh follows 0.1.0-rc.7; release notes compare against the previous Desktop Bundle at `gestalt-v0.1.0`.
